title: Two-step nilpotent monodromy of local systems on special varieties
summary: We address a question of Campana by giving a criterion for when nilpotent local systems on quasi-projective varieties have 2-step nilpotent monodromy. As an application, we prove that the monodromy group of any complex local system on smooth complex quasi-projective variety that is special in the sense of Campana or $h$-special (e.g. containg a Zariski dense entire curve), is virtually 2-step nilpotent.
